episodes.title: Nikki and Jason
episodes.summary: When they learn that another round of IVF would be too expensive and unlikely to succeed, Nikki and Jason start exploring adoption.

episodes.title: The Ex-Girlfriend
episodes.summary: Jason gets in touch with an ex before social services interviews her. Nikki goes out with her sister, Karen, and her unpleasant boyfriend

episodes.title: Tickets for a Queue
episodes.summary: Nikki and Jason go to a picnic with other potential adopters—and get intimidated by the quality of their competition.

episodes.title: Rainbow Castle People
episodes.summary: After a wild night out with Erica and Freddy, Nikki and Jason are faced with potentially disastrous consequences the next morning.

episodes.title: Someone Else's Kids
episodes.summary: Deciding that they need more hands-on experience looking after kids, Nikki and Jason agree to babysit their friends' children for a day.

episodes.title: Show Me the Love
episodes.summary: Jason starts getting cold feet about the whole process after a mandatory training session. Karen tells Nikki some bad news.

episodes.title: Good Old Family Map
episodes.summary: Nikki grows paranoid about Jason after reading a suspicious text on his phone. A family gathering takes a turn for the worse.

episodes.title: We Know the Way Out
episodes.summary: Despite the added irritation of a new roommate, it's time for Nikki and Jason to face the adoption panel.

episodes.title: A Nice Boy
episodes.summary: Nikki and Jason have been approved to adopt, but they're finding the matching process a challenge. Social worker Penny has a plan.

episodes.title: The Sun on Your Back
episodes.summary: Penny sends Nikki and Jason to a fancy-dress party that could change their lives. Nikki helps her sister, Karen, choose a wedding dress.

episodes.title: Big Heads
episodes.summary: Jason's ex threatens to come between him and Nikki at a family funeral. Karen struggles to get Scott involved in their wedding planning.

episodes.title: Helicopters
episodes.summary: Nikki and Jason make a hopeful visit on their adoption journey. Nikki sets Erica up with Jason's friend. Karen is drawn to Deven, a single dad.

episodes.title: Maddest Sweetest Thing
episodes.summary: Nikki and Jason search for a bigger, child-friendly flat. Nikki fights for a promotion at work. Karen is tempted to cheat.

episodes.title: A Long Day Down
episodes.summary: Jason plays detective after a problem is revealed at Ben and Denise's party. Freddy struggles in his relationship.

episodes.title: Lift Me Up
episodes.summary: Planning Scott's stag night is a headache for Jason. Karen shares a secret with Nikki. Erica and Freddy's relationship begins to blur.

episodes.title: I'm Scared
episodes.summary: Nikki and Jason must make a huge decision in a small amount of time.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.summary: Jason and Nikki wake up as the new parents of two kids they've barely met. But will they be able to keep both?

episodes.title: The Circle
episodes.summary: Jason worries that Tyler will be bullied at school. Nikki has to fire someone at work. Bad news from the landlord forces Jason to take a big gamble.

episodes.title: Capture the Flag
episodes.summary: On a camping weekend, Nikki and Jason try to bond with the kids. At home, Karen faces an existential crisis and Freddy realizes he's lonely.

episodes.title: Little Steps
episodes.summary: Planning Tyler's birthday party proves trickier than Nikki and Jason expected—especially when Karen shares some difficult news

episodes.title: Pick a Side
episodes.summary: Jason makes a huge sacrifice for Tyler. Nikki attempts some tough love with Princess. Freddy tries a different sort of group therapy.

episodes.title: Feelings Are the Worst
episodes.summary: Jason and Nikki's future with the kids appears to be in jeopardy after a mistake. Tyler says goodbye to a friend. Scott lands a book deal.

episodes.title: What a Banker
episodes.summary: Scott's book launch doesn't go according to plan. Jason struggles with his new job. Nikki finally masters tough love.

episodes.title: The End of the Beginning
episodes.summary: Season finale. As Nikki and Jason prepare to find out if they can keep the kids forever, they make an impulsive decision that requires their family's help.

episodes.title: The Send-Off
episodes.summary: A loss brings the family together—and also threatens to tear it apart.

episodes.title: Ghosting
episodes.summary: Nikki's impulsiveness sparks an unexpected night out with Jason and a mystery man.

episodes.title: Murder at Slaughterbridge Manor
episodes.summary: A family party leads to a life-changing decision for the birthday boy.

episodes.title: Road Trip
episodes.summary: On a mission to help Tyler fit in, Jason starts a junior soccer team. Nikki, Karen, and Princess travel to Brighton—and one of them has a secret.

episodes.title: Mother's Day
episodes.summary: A celebratory spa visit is surprisingly stressful. Jason's plan to bond his team spins out of control.

episodes.title: Airport Run
episodes.summary: Jason and Nikki's good intentions are derailed by old friends while, unbeknownst to them, their family is about to be rocked.

episodes.title: White Lies
episodes.summary: Nikki looks for answers in Spain. Back at home, Jason has to call in reinforcements to avert a disaster.

episodes.title: Scott of the Atlantic
episodes.summary: Season finale. Scott reaches the point of no return. Jason and his team face a moment of truth. Princess makes a huge discovery.

episodes.title: Rollercoaster
episodes.summary: The fallout from Nikki's lie continues, as Kat's arrival threatens Nikki and Jason's family dynamic.

episodes.title: First Days
episodes.summary: Nikki and Jason start new chapters in their lives. Karen makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: The Mousetrap
episodes.summary: While Jason recaptures his youth, Nikki meets a new coworker. Karen learns the cost of keeping a secret.

episodes.title: The Hurricane
episodes.summary: A natural disaster brings the family together.

episodes.title: Ick
episodes.summary: Jason and Nikki each must face reality. Vic crumbles under the pressure of his own success.

episodes.title: Halloween
episodes.summary: Nikki and Jason's date night is derailed by suspicion, as Princess' night spirals out of control.

episodes.title: Tuscany
episodes.summary: When Nikki and Jason escape to Tuscany, nothing goes as expected—at home or abroad.

episodes.title: WoodScott
episodes.summary: Season finale. Truths begin to emerge at a family festival.
